A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we provide recovery guarantees for one-hidden-layer neural network (1NN) with sample and computational complexity linearly scaling with the dimensionality of input, and logarithmic with the precision.
, under a mild condition, we can recover the ground truth parameters for 1NN with a linear sample complexity and a linear computational complexity, and the recovery is guaranteed to be exact.
we provide recovery guarantees for a wide range of activation functions, and for a large class of 1NNs, we provide both sample complexity and computation complexity guarantees.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 1NN is a powerful model that can be used to recover ground-truth parameters with linear sample complexity and linear computational complexity.
one-hidden-layer networks are much more powerful than previously thought.
the sample complexity of learning a 1NN with gradient descent is linear in the input space dimension d and the activation function can be quite general (e.g., non-differentiable).
